notes: Zero corpus hits for SAM/MobileSAM/Segment-Anything and only 3 hits for 'contour' pool-wide, so no candidate shares the actual model. I scored on the two transferable halves: (a) driving a pretrained torch/CV model with exactly-specified preprocessing on CPU, (b) mask/box/polygon geometry. SWE-Rebench is the weakest pool - deepcell-tf-673 is genuinely on-topic but the rest are only loosely raster/geometry-adjacent, and ranks 5-10 there are filler. RTS is nearly all boilerplate here; the sds-mnist family (clone a named GitHub vision library, install it, run its example unmodified) is the only real transfer and it has ~20 near-duplicates in the pool, so a merge step should expect RTS duplicates. SWE-Smith is dominated by facebookresearch/fvcore, which is legitimately the right ecosystem (detectron2's transform/box ops) - I kept 6 of them rather than padding with unrelated repos.
